Duplicate of `free-slothful-fennecfox` (`be80-8377-4b4c-44f4`), filed by a parallel session
against the same parent bug. Theirs is strictly broader — beyond `reads_cli.py:340,384` it also
covers `descendants.py`, `next_batch.py` and `repo_snapshot.py`. Closing this one in favour of
that; the acceptance criteria here (especially the anchored no-regression halves — an
initialized-empty store must still read empty, and a HEAD-resolvable clone with no `.env-id`
must still return its seeded tickets — plus the revert-to-bare-`isdir` mutation check) are worth
folding into `be80` if they are not already there.
